title: Merchant onboarding request response
description: The details of a merchant onboarding request, including location and business details, and the current status of each integration.

onboardingId.description: The unique reference identifier for the merchant onboarding request.

status.description: The overall status of the onboarding request.

locationDetails.description: Details about the merchant location being onboarded.

address.description: Street address of the merchant location.

postcode.description: Postal code of the merchant location.

countryIsoCode.description: ISO code of the country where the merchant location is situated.

phoneNumber.description: Contact phone number for the merchant location.

abn.description: Australian Business Number (ABN) of the merchant.

entityName.description: Registered entity name of the merchant.

address.description: Street address of the merchant's business.

postcode.description: Postal code of the merchant's business.

countryIsoCode.description: ISO code of the country where the merchant's business is situated.

integrations.description: The list of integrations and their current onboarding status.

status.description: The current status of this integration's onboarding.
